description: Maximaler theoretischer TFA-Eintrag aus abwasserbürtigen Humanarzneimitteln je Landkreis bzw. kreisfreier Stadt (Datensatz) is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. For the very persistent and very mobile compound trifluoroacetate (TFA), the theoretical TFA levy from municipal wastewater treatment plants per district is presented. These were established in the context of the opinion ‘Trifluoroacetate (TFA): Creating the basis for effective minimisation - Spatial analysis of entry pathways into the water cycle’ (duration: August 2021-November 2022). Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Maximum theoretical TFA entry from sewage-borne medicinal products for human use per district/district-free city (datase" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include 2018, Deutschland. The listing shows 2026-05-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
